title: REQ · Report edge cases are proven with an injected clock and fake reporter
summary: Report timing, reporter errors and nil reporter behave as documented
description: Context: Run writes a report using r.now for StartedAt and FinishedAt and returns a reporter error only when the run itself succeeded. Desired behavior: durations come from the injected clock; a reporter error is returned on success but never masks a run error; no reporter means no panic. Why: reports must be trustworthy and never hide failures.
acceptance_criteria: Given a clock advancing one second per call, When Run succeeds, Then the report DurationMS equals FinishedAt minus StartedAt in milliseconds and is greater than 0
Given the agent succeeds and the reporter fails, When Run is called, Then the error wraps the reporter error
Given the agent fails with boom and the reporter fails, When Run is called, Then the error is boom
Given no reporter is set, When Run is called, Then it returns without panic
technical_constraints: Set h.r.now directly in same-package tests
